name: Discover and open a complete profile
description: Verifies the core public discovery journey uses separate pages and a profile opens as its own route.
expected: Discover and the selected profile open as separate views/routes, and the back action returns to Discover.

name: Sign in and create a Nigerian profile
description: Verifies a signed-in adult can create a profile with required identity and location fields.
steps: Enter a display name, age 18 or older, city and bio
expected: The profile saves successfully and the account can reopen My Profile with the saved information.

name: Like another person and create a mutual match
description: Verifies authenticated users can like another profile and mutual likes become a match.
steps: Use Actor B to like Actor A back
expected: The mutual connection appears in Matches and can be opened for messaging.

name: Send and receive a private message
description: Verifies two matched users can open a separate conversation page and exchange a message.
steps: Actor A opens a matched profile
Actor B opens the same conversation
expected: The sent message is visible in the conversation and the recipient can see the updated chat.

name: Block and report safety guidance
description: Verifies the safety controls page is reachable from the main navigation and explains protective actions.
expected: A dedicated Safety page opens with blocking, reporting, privacy and 18+ guidance.
